affirmations.zh: 我的孩子的自闭症不是我的错。我是他需要的家长
affirmations.en: My child's autism is not my fault. I am the parent they need.

affirmations.zh: 我正在用现有的资源做到最好
affirmations.en: I am doing the best I can with what I have today.

affirmations.zh: 每个家庭的旅程都不同。比较会偷走我的平静
affirmations.en: Every family's journey is different. Comparing steals my peace.

affirmations.zh: 哪怕2分钟的自我照顾，也是力量的表现，不是自私
affirmations.en: Even 2 minutes of self-care is an act of strength, not selfishness.

affirmations.zh: 我的孩子是安全的、被爱的、被照顾的。这不是失败
affirmations.en: My child is safe, loved, and cared for. That is not failure.

affirmations.zh: 进步不总是看得见的。小小的步伐也算数
affirmations.en: Progress is not always visible. Small steps count.

affirmations.zh: 现在有成千上万的家长和我有同样的感受。我不是一个人
affirmations.en: Thousands of parents share this exact feeling right now. I am not alone.

affirmations.zh: 我被允许感到挫败。挫败不代表我不爱我的孩子
affirmations.en: I am allowed to feel frustrated. Frustration does not mean I love my child any less.

affirmations.zh: 他在ABA中心每天5.5小时已经在接受专业帮助了。我不需要在家做治疗师
affirmations.en: He gets 5.5 hours of professional help at ABA daily. I don't need to be a therapist at home.

affirmations.zh: 有些日子生存就是胜利。今天就是这样的日子也没关系
affirmations.en: Some days survival is the victory. It's okay if today is one of those days.

permissions.zh: 你今天已经做了足够多。可以停下来了
permissions.en: You have done enough today. It is okay to stop.

permissions.zh: 你的孩子需要一个休息好的家长，而不是一个完美的家长
permissions.en: Your child needs a rested parent, not a perfect one.

permissions.zh: 给自己5分钟不是自私——是必须的
permissions.en: Taking 5 minutes for yourself is not selfish — it is necessary.

permissions.zh: 今晚，你不需要研究、计划或修复任何事情。只需要存在
permissions.en: Tonight, you don't need to research, plan, or fix anything. Just be.

permissions.zh: 照顾好自己，才能更好地照顾他
permissions.en: Take care of yourself first, so you can better care for him.

permissions.zh: 休息不是放弃。休息是为了走更远的路
permissions.en: Rest is not giving up. Rest is preparation for the road ahead.

permissions.zh: 你不需要每件事都做对。你只需要在场
permissions.en: You don't need to get everything right. You just need to be present.

permissions.zh: 允许自己今晚什么都不做
permissions.en: Allow yourself to do nothing tonight.

microTips.zh: 研究显示：自闭症家长的压力水平相当于战区退伍军人。你面对的确实很难
microTips.en: Research shows: ASD parents experience stress levels comparable to combat veterans. What you face is genuinely hard.

microTips.zh: 研究证明：每天5分钟的正念练习就能降低皮质醇水平、改善情绪
microTips.en: Studies show: just 5 minutes of daily mindfulness reduces cortisol and improves mood.

microTips.zh: 自我关怀不是自我怜悯。研究表明它实际上让你成为更有效的家长
microTips.en: Self-compassion is not self-pity. Research shows it actually makes you a more effective parent.

microTips.zh: 同时感到悲伤和爱是正常的。两种感受都是有效的
microTips.en: It is normal to grieve and love at the same time. Both feelings are valid.

microTips.zh: 寻求帮助不是软弱。建立支持网络是最有效的应对策略之一
microTips.en: Asking for help is not weakness. Building a support network is one of the most effective coping strategies.

microTips.zh: 研究表明：每天15-20分钟的有意识互动就足以产生显著效果
microTips.en: Research shows: just 15-20 minutes of intentional interaction daily makes a significant impact.
